timeline.query: who were the rectors of eth between 2017 and 2022?

timeline.draft_answer: Based on the chunks: Sarah Springman served as Rector of ETH Zurich until the end of January 2022. The chunks do not explicitly cover who was rector in 2017 or name all rectors throughout the 2017–2022 period.
